listing.description: Up to 4 Months Free* Inspired studio, 1, 2, and 3 bedroom luxury apartments in the heart of Jersey City. AVIVA's modern residences offer  spacious layouts with refined style and scenic views, alongside lifestyle amenities curated to support health, wellness, productivity, and more. Surround yourself with the natural beauty of Liberty State Park while being moments from the train and only 5 miles from Lower Manhattan, in a community committed to green living and seamless ease.*Rents shown reflect net-effective pricing for select apartments inclusive of concessions.
